purpose: Freeze the verified HeroFetter CompletionConditions semantics for canonical Hero Stage 5-1 without declaring the final production block complete before its final gate runs.

verifiedRule.parm1: Hero ID whose favorability is evaluated
verifiedRule.canonicalOrientation: Parm1 equals the owning canonical Hero ID for all 1335 rows

conditionType1.notes: Matthew's five source thresholds (12/32/52/72/92) are preserved as data and are not normalized to the common 5/10/15/23/25 pattern. The enum provides the semantic label; the full canonical relation validates Parm1 ownership.

verifiedRule.missionStageJoin: When MissionInfo.MissionType == 5 and MissionInfo.Param2 == 6, MissionInfo.Param3 -> ConfigDataHeroDungeonLevelInfo.ID; stage ownership is derived by reverse-indexing ConfigDataHeroInformationInfo.DungeonLevels_ID[].
verifiedRule.candidateResolver: canonical(MissionInfo.Param1) UNION canonical(HeroInformationInfo.ID that reverse-owns MissionInfo.Param3 via DungeonLevels_ID[]) MINUS FetterOwnerHeroId
verifiedRule.requiredHeroResolver: the sole remaining canonical Hero candidate
verifiedRule.importantOrientationRule: MissionInfo.Param1 is not always the required Hero and the Param3 stage owner is not always the required Hero; either side can be the Fetter owner. Resolve by set subtraction against the Fetter owner.
verifiedRule.otherCanonicalType2Rows: MissionType 5/Param2 2 or 5, MissionType 29, and MissionType 34 do not produce an external required-Hero edge in the verified canonical scope.

decision.reasonStageNotComplete: Both CompletionCondition types are semantically frozen, and the 267-Hero production candidate is structurally clean. A final production transformation/gate must still emit the display-ready Type1 interpretation and hero-page-stage5-1-final.v1.json.
decision.nextStartPoint: Transform the frozen production candidate so Type1 emits favorability target/required-level semantics, validate all 267 Hero bond blocks, and freeze hero-page-stage5-1-final.v1.json.
